description: Household money checkup for Korea: from monthly take-home pay, living costs, saving, loan repayment, protection insurance premiums and the emergency fund, returns the emergency-fund months, saving rate, debt-repayment ratio and insurance ratio, each compared with common rule-of-thumb lines (3–6 months; saving 20%+; repayment 40% or less, cf. bank DSR 40%; insurance 10% or less) and marked good, watch or fix. Rules of thumb, not law; no tax; no product or investment recommendation.
